mentions.name: Frontier LLM CAD modeling experiment
mentions.description: This experiment tests whether frontier LLMs can do practical CAD modeling, using a single task: designing a wall mount for a bike pump in OpenSCAD or CadQuery. Since prompting LLMs with photos and a written description produces unusable designs, it adds a Mujoco simulator the LLMs can use to test and iterate on their designs. The goal is an interesting blog post and possibly a usable wall mount design.
mentions.problem: Frontier LLMs (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) do not produce usable CAD designs when prompted with only photos and a written description of the part.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm experimenting to see if frontier LLMs can do practical CAD modeling. I'm starting with a single task: designing a wall mount for my bike pump in OpenSCAD or CadQuery (two code-based CAD systems).

None of the frontier LLMs (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) produce usable designs when just prompted with some photos of the pump and a written description of the mount. I'm now building a simulator in Mujoco that the LLMs can use to test and iterate on their designs to see if they can do better in this setting.
